video: 30-second vertical explainer that shows how retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) works

question_enter.what: The question pill fades in, rises slightly and grows from 96% to full size

question_travel.what: The question pill glides to a new area of the scene, following the camera

question_into_model.what: The question pill shrinks and disappears into the AI model circle

question_reemerge.what: The question pill comes back out of the AI model and settles above the answer

empty_answer_enter.what: An empty AI answer card fades in and rises into place

empty_answer_exit.what: The empty AI answer card fades away as the camera leaves

typing_dots.what: Three dots pulse in a loop inside the empty answer card, like someone typing

answer_stuck_mark.what: The typing dots stop and a large question mark fades in inside the empty card

camera_pan.what: The camera pans smoothly across the scene to the next area of the process

camera_recap_zoom.what: The camera zooms out to show the whole process at once

document_enter.what: Two document cards fade in at the edge of the frame

document_unfold.what: Each document card unfolds downward, revealing its lines of text

chunk_split.what: Text cards slide out of the documents into a grid, one after another

chunk_to_dot.what: Each text card shrinks into a small dot and flies into a circular map

map_ring_draw.what: The circular map's outline draws itself around the dots

map_rings_rotate.what: Dotted rings inside the map turn slowly and continuously

other_dots_enter.what: More dots from other documents fade into the map

retrieval_pulse.what: A ring expands outward from the question across the map at a steady speed

relevant_dot_highlight.what: A dot that matches the question changes from lavender to strong violet when the ring reaches it

irrelevant_dot_dim.what: A dot that does not match fades to gray when the ring reaches it

retrieval_link_draw.what: A dotted violet line grows from the question to each matching dot

retrieved_rise.what: The matching dots grow back into labeled cards and rise to stack above the question

cards_into_prompt.what: The question and the three cards slide together into a box labeled Prompt

prompt_box_draw.what: The Prompt box outline draws itself

model_draw_fill.what: The AI model circle outline draws itself, then fills with a soft color

cards_absorbed.what: The cards in the prompt shrink and disappear into the AI model circle

model_pulse.what: The AI model circle briefly swells and settles as the prompt enters it

model_ring_spin.what: A dashed ring inside the AI model turns continuously, faster while it is working

answer_card_enter.what: The answer card fades in and rises into place below the model

answer_typing.what: The answer text appears word by word at a steady pace

source_tags_emerge.what: Small source tags come out of the AI model and settle in a row below the answer

source_connectors.what: Dotted violet lines draw down from the answer to each source tag

journey_path_reveal.what: A dotted line traces the route the question has traveled through the scene

recap_stage_glow.what: The map, the prompt box and the answer card glow one after another as their stage is named

headline_reveal.what: Each headline line slides up into view from behind an invisible edge

headline_exit.what: The headline fades out at the end of its scene

subtitle_words.what: Subtitle words brighten in groups of three as the narrator says them

logo_bars_grow.what: Four logo bars grow upward from a baseline one after another, left to right

logo_wordmark_reveal.what: The brand name is revealed left to right by a moving edge

logo_glow.what: The logo bars glow brighter, then settle to a soft glow

tagline_enter.what: The tagline fades in and rises into place under the logo

cta_enter.what: The call-to-action button fades in and rises into place

cta_arrow_nudge.what: The arrow on the button slides a little to the right once

world_fade_out.what: The whole process scene fades away before the logo appears
